title: Proposal to Increase Frequency of Tree Inspections
what_it_is: Proposal to Increase Frequency of Tree Inspections

sections.label: NParks tree inspection frequency
sections.summary: NParks increased tree inspection frequency, inspecting expressway and major road trees every six to 12 months since 2012 and older trees annually since 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: More specifically, NParks has increased its tree inspection frequency to address unpredictable and severe weather conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For example, trees along expressways and major roads used to be inspected every 12 to 18 months.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since 2012, trees in these locations have been inspected every six to 12 months.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since 2016, NParks has also instituted an annual second-level inspection for older trees of more than four metres in girth.

sections.label: Tree failure incidents and assistance
sections.summary: Tree failure incidents in 2017 were the lowest on record at 406, down 60% since 2012, with NParks training stakeholders and assisting the affected public.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: With these checks and measures, the number of tree failure incidents in 2017 was the lowest on record at 406, having declined by 60% since 2012.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks is also supporting other stakeholders, like the Housing Development Board and JTC, which manage trees in Singapore by providing technical training on tree health and maintenance.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: If members of the public are affected by a fallen tree, they can use the OneService mobile app to report the incident or call the NParks hotline.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: NParks and the relevant agencies will do whatever they can to render assistance to those affected.
